## Description {#details}

<p>Equivalence classes for small integers.</p>


<p>This is a mapping of the integers 0 .. N-1 into M equivalence classes numbered 0 .. M-1.</p>


<p>Initially each integer has its own equivalence class. Classes are joined by passing a representative member of each class to join().</p>


<p>Once the classes are built, compress() will number them 0 .. M-1 and prevent further changes.</p>
